title: vl06: qubit time evolution with H = sigma_x has no energy unit: cos(t/hbar)
reason: t/hbar has the unit 1/energy; the argument of cos must be dimensionless. With H = epsilon sigma_x (epsilon an energy) it is epsilon t/hbar. The same applies to the figure fig_vl06_messung (angular velocity 2 epsilon/hbar).
